```{r ,echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, cache=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.height=13,fig.width=10, out.width="100%"}

# ======================================================
# Clustered plant family × pollinator genus heatmap
# Based on the outputs:
#   SES_genus.rds
#   pval_df_genus.rds
#   block_mats_genus.rds
# ======================================================

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)

# -----------------------------
# Settings
# -----------------------------

alpha <- 0.05
top_n_plants <- 18

cat_levels <- c(
  "Avoidance",
  "No difference",
  "Preference"
)

plot_cols <- c(
  "Avoidance" = "#F1A340",
  "No difference" = "grey85",
  "Preference" = "#7B3294"
)

poll_order <- c(
  "Hymenoptera",
  "Diptera",
  "Coleoptera",
  "Lepidoptera"
)

# -----------------------------
# Load outputs and raw data
# -----------------------------

SES <- readRDS(
  "../Data/Working_files/SES_genus.rds"
)

pval_df <- readRDS(
  "../Data/Working_files/pval_df_genus.rds"
)

block_mats <- readRDS(
  "../Data/Working_files/block_mats_genus.rds"
)

raw_data <- readRDS(
  "../Data/Working_files/interaction_data.rds"
)

# Confirm that the matrices have names
stopifnot(
  !is.null(rownames(SES)),
  !is.null(colnames(SES))
)

# ======================================================
# Count plant species within each plant family
# ======================================================

plant_n_species <- raw_data %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Plant_family),
    !is.na(Plant_accepted_name)
  ) %>%
  distinct(
    Plant_family,
    Plant_accepted_name
  ) %>%
  count(
    Plant_family,
    name = "n_species"
  )

# ======================================================
# Count pollinator species within each pollinator genus
# ======================================================

pollinator_genus_n_species <- raw_data %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Pollinator_genus),
    !is.na(Pollinator_accepted_name),
    Pollinator_rank == "SPECIES",
    Pollinator_order %in% poll_order
  ) %>%
  distinct(
    Pollinator_genus,
    Pollinator_accepted_name
  ) %>%
  count(
    Pollinator_genus,
    name = "n_species"
  )

# ======================================================
# Convert the SES matrix to long format
# ======================================================

heat_df <- as.data.frame(SES) %>%
  rownames_to_column("Plant_family") %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -Plant_family,
    names_to = "Pollinator_genus",
    values_to = "SES"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    pval_df,
    by = c(
      "Plant_family",
      "Pollinator_genus"
    )
  )

# Check that all non-missing SES values matched a p-value
n_missing_pvalues <- heat_df %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(SES),
    is.na(p_two)
  ) %>%
  nrow()

if (n_missing_pvalues > 0) {
  warning(
    n_missing_pvalues,
    " non-missing SES values did not have a matching p-value."
  )
}

# Retain cells for which SES and p-values could be calculated
heat_df <- heat_df %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(SES),
    !is.na(p_two)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    category = case_when(
      p_two < alpha & SES < 0 ~ "Avoidance",
      p_two < alpha & SES > 0 ~ "Preference",
      TRUE ~ "No difference"
    ),
    category = factor(
      category,
      levels = cat_levels
    )
  )

# ======================================================
# Select plant families with the strongest SES signal
# ======================================================

plant_keep <- heat_df %>%
  group_by(Plant_family) %>%
  summarise(
    signal = sum(abs(SES), na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  slice_max(
    order_by = signal,
    n = top_n_plants,
    with_ties = FALSE
  ) %>%
  pull(Plant_family)

heat_df <- heat_df %>%
  filter(
    Plant_family %in% plant_keep
  )

# ======================================================
# Construct SES matrix for hierarchical clustering
# ======================================================

ses_mat <- heat_df %>%
  select(
    Plant_family,
    Pollinator_genus,
    SES
  ) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Pollinator_genus,
    values_from = SES,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  column_to_rownames("Plant_family") %>%
  as.matrix()

# -----------------------------
# Cluster plant families
# -----------------------------

if (nrow(ses_mat) > 1) {
  plant_order <- rownames(ses_mat)[
    hclust(dist(ses_mat))$order
  ]
} else {
  plant_order <- rownames(ses_mat)
}

# -----------------------------
# Cluster pollinator genera
# -----------------------------

if (ncol(ses_mat) > 1) {
  pollinator_order <- colnames(ses_mat)[
    hclust(dist(t(ses_mat)))$order
  ]
} else {
  pollinator_order <- colnames(ses_mat)
}

# ======================================================
# Labels containing species richness
# ======================================================

plant_labels <- plant_n_species %>%
  filter(
    Plant_family %in% plant_order
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    label = paste0(
      Plant_family,
      " (",
      n_species,
      ")"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    Plant_family,
    label
  ) %>%
  deframe()

pollinator_labels <- pollinator_genus_n_species %>%
  filter(
    Pollinator_genus %in% pollinator_order
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    label = paste0(
      Pollinator_genus,
      " (",
      n_species,
      ")"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    Pollinator_genus,
    label
  ) %>%
  deframe()

# Fallback labels when no richness value is available
missing_plant_labels <- setdiff(
  plant_order,
  names(plant_labels)
)

if (length(missing_plant_labels) > 0) {
  plant_labels[missing_plant_labels] <- missing_plant_labels
}

missing_pollinator_labels <- setdiff(
  pollinator_order,
  names(pollinator_labels)
)

if (length(missing_pollinator_labels) > 0) {
  pollinator_labels[missing_pollinator_labels] <-
    missing_pollinator_labels
}

# ======================================================
# Apply ordering and labels
# ======================================================

heat_df <- heat_df %>%
  mutate(
    Plant_family = factor(
      Plant_family,
      levels = plant_order,
      labels = unname(
        plant_labels[plant_order]
      )
    ),
    Pollinator_genus = factor(
      Pollinator_genus,
      levels = rev(pollinator_order),
      labels = unname(
        rev(pollinator_labels[pollinator_order])
      )
    )
  )

# ======================================================
# Plot
# ======================================================

p_heat <- ggplot(
  heat_df,
  aes(
    x = Plant_family,
    y = Pollinator_genus,
    fill = category
  )
) +
  geom_tile(
    colour = "white",
    linewidth = 0.35,
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = plot_cols,
    breaks = cat_levels,
    labels = cat_levels,
    name = "Observed against null",
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  guides(
    fill = guide_legend(
      nrow = 1,
      byrow = TRUE,
      title.position = "top",
      title.hjust = 0.5,
      override.aes = list(
        alpha = 1
      )
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Plant family",
    y = "Pollinator genus"
  ) +
  scale_y_discrete(
    position = "right",
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  theme_classic(
    base_size = 13
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 60,
      hjust = 1,
      vjust = 1,
      size = 12
    ),
    axis.text.y = element_text(
      size = 11
    ),
    axis.title = element_text(
      size = 18,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),

    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.direction = "horizontal",
    legend.title = element_text(
      size = 12,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    legend.text = element_text(
      size = 11
    ),
    legend.key.width = grid::unit(
      1.3,
      "cm"
    ),
    legend.key.height = grid::unit(
      0.55,
      "cm"
    ),
    legend.background = element_rect(
      colour = "black",
      fill = "white",
      linewidth = 1
    ),
    legend.margin = margin(
      t = 5,
      r = 8,
      b = 5,
      l = 8
    ),
    plot.margin = margin(
      t = 5,
      r = 5,
      b = 5,
      l = 22
    )
  )

p_heat
```
